MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

2. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Marketing? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Marketing.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Marketing.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Marketing.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Physiology.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Physiology.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Physiology.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
